test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 3 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Among the following propositions two are related in such a way that one is the denial of the other. Which are those propositions?

Propositions:

(a) All elephants are equal to cats.

(b) Some elephants are not equal to cats.

(c) Some elephants are equal to cats.

(d) Few elephants are also equal to cats.
solution:
From the given prepositions:

(a) All elephants are equal to cats.

(b) Some elephants are not equal to cats.

(c) Some elephants are equal to cats.

(d) Few elephants are also equal to cats.

We consider each option:

Option 1) **(a) and (b) -- **(a) says 'All elephants are equal to cats' and (b) says 'Some elephants are not equal to cats' which are two contradicting prepositions and are denial of each other.

Option 2) **(c) and (d) -- **(c) says 'Some elephants are equal to cats' and (d) says 'Few elephants are also equal to cats', these two prepositions are similar to each other and cannot be denial.

Option 3) **(a) and (d) -- **(a) says 'All elephants are equal to cats' and (d) says 'Few elephants are also equal to cats', here both of them are in accordance with each other and there is no denial.

Option 4) **(a) and (c) -- **(a) says 'All elephants are equal to cats' and (c) says 'Some elephants are equal to cats', we can see that both the prepositions are leading towards the same idea and there is no denial of any sort.

So, (a) and (b) **are in denial.**

Hence** the correct answer is option 1)**
